definitions: A substance applied to skin, clothing, or other surfaces to prevent insects (and arthropods in general) from landing or climbing on that surface.
A chemical or natural product designed to deter insects from an area or from biting/stinging a person.
examples: Don't forget to pack insect repellent for your trip.
She sprayed insect repellent on her arms and legs.
The shop sells various brands of insect repellent.
